messages:
Alex (New Hire): hi all — first week q: who do i ping for GCP project quotas and network egress allowances? trying to get the sample app talking to the hosted runtime and ran into a 403 when calling the api.
Maya (People Ops): welcome! :tada: for infra provisioning start with eng-infra, but we have a short guide: https://redwood.internal/onboard/provisioning — will DM checklist.
Samir (Eng): @Alex for project-level quotas (GPU nodes, IPs, VPC peering) ping eng-infra. If it's a runtime API auth 403, include the request id and exact curl.
Alex (New Hire): thanks — error is `403 Forbidden: service-identity-mismatch` from the hosted endpoint. curl below:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"redwood-v1"}'
```
Samir (Eng): looks like a token scope issue. Are you using the demo token or the org token? org tokens need the `inference:invoke` scope.
Elaine (Eng-Infra): i can add the org token scope once Priya confirms the project id. @Alex can you paste the project id and the email of the service account?
Alex (New Hire): project: redwood-dev-42, svc acct: alex-dev@redwood-dev.iam.gserviceaccount.com
Elaine (Eng-Infra): noted, i'll start the grant and ping when done. ETA ~20m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Jin (Platform): fyi escalation path for runtime outages: first page eng-runtime channel, then eng-sre (Priya) if infra-level, then oncall rotation. For access blockers, eng-infra usually handles grants during 9-5 PT, outside that file a ticket and include the `first week` tag.
Priya (Eng-SRE): Oncall Bot, can you post today's oncall for infra?
Oncall Bot: Eng-Infra oncall: Priya (primary), Marcus (secondary). Shift: 2026-03-23 07:00 - 2026-03-24 07:00 UTC.
Alex (New Hire): perfect — should I do anything else to avoid scope issues?
Samir (Eng): make sure your local trainer uses the org token and that you don't mix sandbox/demo tokens. also add your IP to the allowlist if you hit egress blocks (see link Maya posted).
Maya (People Ops): also adding you to #dev-new-hires pairing session at 3pm — Samir offered to walk through the runtime flow. :wave:
Alex (New Hire): thanks everyone — appreciate the quick help! will report back once grant lands. :thumbsup:
Elaine (Eng-Infra): grant applied. you should have `inference:invoke` now — test and LMK.
Alex (New Hire): confirmed — curl works now, no 403. thanks!
Jin (Platform): noting for future hires: common owners for "who-to-ask" — eng-infra (provisioning, quotas), eng-runtime (api/auth issues), eng-platform (routing/policies), eng-sre (oncall/incidents). we'll add a short map to the onboarding doc.
Maya (People Ops): i'll update the onboarding checklist with that owner map this afternoon.
Alex (New Hire): awesome — closing this thread.
